ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: RwLock::with_max_readers and const_with_max_readers now panic when max_reads=0. Previously, max_reads=0 caused write()/try_write() to acquire 0 permits, breaking mutual exclusion and enabling use-after-free / UB. debug_assert_ne!(self.mr, 0) is added in write paths as defense-in-depth, and regression tests cover the panic for both constructors.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title: 'Require that an RwLock has max_readers != 0'. Body explicitly describes the UB: 'write locks do not ensure mutual exclusion because they acquire 0 permits ... This can be abused to trigger UB' with a UAF reproducer. Reviewer ADD-SP confirmed via Miri reporting UAF. Maintainer flagged this needs backport, indicating a real soundness fix in a public API.

ai_baseline.notes: Correctly identifies the UB mechanism: write acquires self.mr permits, so mr=0 grants exclusive access while readers hold permits. Covers both assumption_boundary (with_max_readers) and external_contract (const constructor public API change).

fact_only.notes: Top finding correctly flags boundary_condition_changed on the new assert (maps to assumption_boundary). #2 prod_change_with_tests is supporting only. Does not separately surface external_contract / public-API panic change.

semantic_filtered.notes: Only emits a generic prod_change_with_tests claim; never names the max_reads=0 boundary or the write-permit mutual-exclusion mechanism. Filter dropped the direct boundary_condition_changed evidence that fact-only retained.
